snippet.title: "CaTHaRSiS〜The last of atelier〜" 1st Trailer
snippet.description:
CaTHaRSiS〜The last of atelier〜 
Steam Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4995880

Knowing nothing of who you are, you step into the worlds of iconic masterpieces.
Walk through paintings, gather “memories,” and fill your empty vessel in this immersive art adventure. At the end of a journey through beautiful memories, what “world” will you paint?

－－－－－－－－－－
